waybackify cache fill [flags] <dir>

Fetch every capture a ledger references into a cache root

Drive a cache root to a COMPLETE asset closure of every capture the
ledger under <dir> references — each referenced page AND its
requisites (im_/cs_/js_/oe_). The bulk, resumable form of `cache add` —
the whole-corpus population path (wrap it in a thin repo shim).
Pages (flagless replay URLs) are always fetched before content named
with a replay flag; --pages-only stops after the pages.

A durable worklist (never-fetched + not-yet-closed captures) is
enumerated ONCE and reused across runs, so pacing and resume
accumulate. Transient archive.org trouble DEFERS a capture (retried
next run); a run of connection failures ABORTS (archive.org down);
a 404 is recorded gone and never retried. Killable + resumable — the
cache root is the done-truth; re-run to finish.

The worklist is stamped with the ledger that built it and rebuilt
when the ledger changes. A run of captures that defer with nothing
fetched (archive.org throttling) STOPS the run; the next one starts
after the streak. --converge repeats passes, backing off after a
stop or a pass with no progress, until nothing fetches or defers.

Output: progress on stderr; one JSON summary line on stdout. Exit 0
normal (deferrals expected — re-run to converge), 1 on a stop
(archive.org unreachable or throttling — the mirror is incomplete,
re-run) or, under --converge, when the worklist did not converge.

Arguments:
  <dir>                    root to discover wayback.json manifests under

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>         cache root to populate + measure closure against — required
  --delay-ms <n>           pacing between captures — a page + its requisites fetch together, browser-style (default 1500)
  --abort-after <n>        consecutive connection failures before aborting (default 5)
  --throttle-after <n>     consecutive captures deferred with nothing fetched before stopping (default 6; 0 = never)
  --request-delay-ms <n>   pacing between the requisite requests of one capture (default 0)
  --no-requisites          store only the named captures; record their requisite edges, fetch none
  --pages-only             attempt only the pages (flagless replay URLs); leave id_/im_/oe_ content pending
  --max <n>                cap captures fetched this run, then exit (default: no cap)
  --refresh                rebuild the worklist even when the ledger is unchanged
  --converge               repeat passes until nothing fetches or defers
  --backoff-s <n>          converge: first backoff after a stop or a no-progress pass (default 300)
  --backoff-max-s <n>      converge: backoff ceiling; the backoff doubles up to it (default 1800)
  --max-stall <n>          converge: consecutive no-progress passes before giving up (default 6)
  --dry-run                build/show the worklist; fetch nothing
  --help|-h                Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
